844	Know that a Torah scholar who gives counsel to the people of his generation is
845	like an umbrella that protects the whole community.
846	Decrees, troubles are turned away by his austerities,
847	by his unifications, by his fear of Heaven, by his devekut
848	and love.
849	He protects everyone: "He turned away My wrath from the children of
850	Israel." Wrath was meant to come, and he turned
851	it back, "and He is merciful, forgives iniquity." Here too, to turn back,
852	to turn back the anger of the Holy One, blessed be He,
853	the burning anger, from the community. In whose merit? In the merit of being
854	attached to the Rav. The Rav is an encircling light. A person has so many troubles,
855	so many problems; he needs an encircling light
856	to protect him.
857	As long as Israel were surrounded by the encircling light, which is
858	the Clouds of Glory, nothing happened to them. Only when it was removed
859	from them, "the clouds…" — "the Canaanite king of
860	Arad, who dwelt in the Negev, heard." The Canaanite in the Negev, not far. "Then
861	the Canaanite…" and he took some of them captive. He came to wage war
862	against Israel. As long as an encircling light is upon you,
863	nothing will happen to you: problems, suffering, troubles. What are
864	problems? Go to hospitals, you will see people choking with pain.
865	Go to people, to rabbis: people crying over them day
866	and night about their livelihood, their wife,
867	their children. Troubles, from here until further notice. You
868	don't want that. Who wants that? So what
869	do you do? Encircling light. You must constantly channel,
870	channel the encircling light. If you don't channel the encircling light,
871	the problems will come, because the encircling light will weaken. It's like
872	fuel. You must constantly fuel up the car.
873	Soon it will be the 17th of Tamuz. Why do we fast
874	on the 17th of Tamuz? What is the fast? One of the five things
875	that befell our forefathers on the 17th of Tamuz:
876	the walls were breached.
877	The walls were breached, the walls were breached, and on the Ninth of
878	Av, the Temple. What do I need to fast for on the 17th of
879	Tamuz? That the walls were breached. How do
880	you not notice that in the end the blow comes upon
881	the Beit HaMikdash? As long as the walls surrounding
882	Yerushalayim were intact, Yerushalayim was protected. The
883	walls were breached, the physical wall was breached;
884	the encircling light was cut off.
885	Now the next thing can arrive: first Yerushalayim, then
886	the next thing, the Temple Mount, the Beit HaMikdash. The writing
887	was on the wall, and we did not awaken.
888	They will come and destroy the Beit HaMikdash. Why? They breached,
889	because the daily offering stopped. As long as they offered the
890	daily offering on the altar, they channeled encircling light.
891	The walls were intact: encircling light over Yerushalayim. This is
892	the secret of "Yerushalayim, mountains surround her." This is the secret
893	that Yerushalayim is a walled city: all the time there is encircling
894	light around it. When they stopped offering the sacrifice, they stopped
895	channeling,
896	pleading with the Shechinah to guard Yerushalayim with the encircling light,
897	the wall was breached. After the wall is breached:
898	troubles, problems, destruction, death, plagues,
899	sufferings.
900	The same with a person in his life. It is all
901	a miniature of your life. As long as you channel
902	strength to the Shechinah to guard you, Torah and fear of Heaven,
903	and most important, love of the sages,
904	"seat them on the knees of the sages,"
905	and devekut to the sages, who show you the way. If
906	not for the sages, the eyes of the congregation, we would
907	have been lost long ago. They are the leaders, they tell
908	us the way. Each one knows exactly which
909	Rav he follows. Each connects to a different Rav, as long
910	as he is God-fearing, so that he sees the Rav as though
911	above him: "I am empty and the Rav above me
912	is full. Would that I could, amen, I would give everything to
913	be like him."
914	That is how one must think. Exactly like that.
915	Then automatically you draw encircling light, the light
916	surrounds you all the time. Stop making encircling light, stop
917	your Torah classes, stop the mitzvot.
918	The encircling light slowly weakens until the
919	walls are breached. The Ninth of Av, heaven forbid, destruction. That is
920	exactly how it is. And what I am telling you, there are introductions
921	in Kabbalah for everything I am speaking about now. These are not
922	my lectures. Whoever is wise will repent;
923	let him learn from Miriam, learn from the spies, learn
924	from Korach. Why are these parashot written for us
925	in the Torah at all? If not so that we take from them
926	for the service of HaShem, if not so that we learn what happened
927	to them. Every year we read it, not for nothing, so that
928	we learn what happened to them, that they saw the Rav as if
929	he were nothing to them. They saw the Rav as nothing, and that's it. So
930	that is destruction:

937	the Shechinah leaves. There is no such thing as empty. The pit has

940	in nature. Nature does not tolerate emptiness. Dig a pit, there
941	will not remain emptiness there. There are snakes and scorpions in that pit.
942	If you do not put water in it, fill it with water, then
943	there will be water, there will be no snakes and scorpions. This is exactly
944	your heart too: it is like a pit. Fill it with Torah,
945	all of you, up to the top, to the opening of the pit, which is the mouth,
946	with water, with Torah, with holiness, with fear of Heaven, with praise of

948	You begin to speak about sages, you see the sages as though

951	that come from the heart and enter the heart,

954	and who seeks the honor of the Shechinah. May the Holy One, blessed be
